summary: First measurements on the kabylake node: R's default build with GCC 16 as upstream GCC, the C dialect of each release's time, recommended packages
Releases of every Ubuntu LTS on the kabylake machine: 3 processes per benchmark, the sentinel and probe before every run, results from r-benchmarks main

4 processes per benchmark, each on its own code layout of the build; a 1 ms pause before every iteration; t-intervals with a 0.1% floor; mathkernel/MMM-T1 left out; the profile pass; other implementations (rcp) against the GNU R they are built on
